reason: I already ask my AI chat app for recipes and it answers as many questions as I want, for free. I only cook on weekends, so paying for recipes in an app where the chef takes 3 questions a day doesn't make sense to me.
objection: Two free dishes is nothing, I'd be through them in two dinners, and I already know basil pork, so I'd never get far enough to see if it's really better than my free AI. The 99 baht isn't the problem, it's paying for something I basically already get free.
would_change_my_mind: If I cooked the free green curry one Saturday and it came out clearly better than when I follow my AI chat, I'd pay the 99 baht, it's less than one delivery order.
